summary_en: Interim dividend per share raised to ¥50.00 from ¥45.00, with full-year dividend forecast revised to ¥100.00 from ¥90.00, reflecting ¥5.00 per share increase in both interim and year-end dividends for fiscal year ending March 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Dividend Payment (Interim Dividend) and Revision of Projected Year-End Dividend (Increase)
translation_en_brief:
On November 9, 2026, the board of directors resolved to increase the interim dividend per share for fiscal year 2027 to ¥50.00, up from the previously forecast ¥45.00. The full-year dividend forecast was simultaneously revised to ¥100.00, up from ¥90.00. Both the interim and year-end dividends reflect a ¥5.00 per share increase compared to the forecast announced on May 11, 2026. The record date for the interim dividend is September 30, 2026, with an effective date of December 1, 2026.

The company stated that enhancing shareholder returns is a key management objective. The dividend increases reflect a comprehensive assessment of business performance and future prospects, while maintaining the fundamental policy of providing stable, sustainable dividends to shareholders over the long term. The company determined that current conditions warranted accelerated profit return to shareholders through these dividend hikes.
